title: "Dashboard: Salud Mental en Adolescentes"
author: "Sebastian Albornoz"
lang: es
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    orientation: rows
server: shiny
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

candidatos <- c(
  file.path("..", "datos", "dataset.csv"),
  file.path("..", "datos", "Teen_Mental_Health.csv"),
  "dataset.csv"
)
archivo <- candidatos[file.exists(candidatos)][1]

datos <- read.csv(
  archivo,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
  check.names = FALSE
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    depression_label = as.character(depression_label),
    depresion = if_else(depression_label == "1", "Con depresion", "Sin depresion")
  )

variables_numericas <- datos |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  names()
```

# Resumen

## Row {height="25%"}

### Observaciones

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Observaciones"
#| icon: "people"
#| color: primary
nrow(datos)
```

### Edad promedio

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Edad promedio"
#| icon: "calendar3"
#| color: info
round(mean(datos$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

### Horas en redes

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Horas diarias en redes"
#| icon: "phone"
#| color: warning
round(mean(datos$daily_social_media_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

### Riesgo de salud mental

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Puntaje de riesgo (media)"
#| icon: "heart-pulse"
#| color: danger
round(mean(datos$mental_health_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

## Row {height="75%"}

### Indicadores promedio

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
datos |>
  summarise(
    Sueño = mean(sleep_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    Estres = mean(stress_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ansiedad = mean(anxiety_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Rendimiento academico` = mean(academic_performance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "indicador", values_to = "valor") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = indicador, y = valor, fill = indicador)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(valor, 2)), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Promedio", title = "Promedios de indicadores de bienestar") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```

# Exploracion interactiva

## Sidebar {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput(
  "variable_num",
  "Variable numerica",
  choices = variables_numericas,
  selected = "mental_health_risk_score"
)

selectInput(
  "genero",
  "Genero",
  choices = c("Todos", sort(unique(datos$gender))),
  selected = "Todos"
)

selectInput(
  "bienestar",
  "Bienestar digital",
  choices = c("Todos", sort(unique(datos$digital_wellbeing_flag))),
  selected = "Todos"
)
```

## Row

### Histograma

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
filtrar_datos <- function(data, genero, bienestar) {
  resultado <- data
  if (genero != "Todos") {
    resultado <- resultado |> filter(gender == genero)
  }
  if (bienestar != "Todos") {
    resultado <- resultado |> filter(digital_wellbeing_flag == bienestar)
  }
  resultado
}

renderPlot({
  filtrado <- filtrar_datos(datos, input$genero, input$bienestar)

  ggplot(filtrado, aes(x = .data[[input$variable_num]])) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "#2F80ED", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribucion de", input$variable_num),
      subtitle = paste(nrow(filtrado), "observaciones con los filtros actuales"),
      x = "Valor",
      y = "Frecuencia"
    )
})
```

### Diagrama de caja

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
renderPlot({
  filtrado <- filtrar_datos(datos, input$genero, input$bienestar)

  ggplot(filtrado, aes(y = .data[[input$variable_num]])) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "#27AE60", outlier.color = "#C0392B") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Diagrama de caja:", input$variable_num),
      y = "Valor"
    )
})
```

# Perfil del dataset

## Row {height="50%"}

### Plataformas

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
datos |>
  count(platform_usage, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(platform_usage = fct_reorder(platform_usage, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = platform_usage, y = n, fill = platform_usage)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Frecuencia", title = "Uso de plataformas")
```

### Bienestar digital

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
datos |>
  count(digital_wellbeing_flag) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = digital_wellbeing_flag, y = n, fill = digital_wellbeing_flag)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Frecuencia", title = "Bandera de bienestar digital")
```

## Row {height="50%"}

### Redes sociales y riesgo

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(datos, aes(x = daily_social_media_hours, y = mental_health_risk_score, color = depresion)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Horas diarias en redes",
    y = "Puntaje de riesgo",
    color = "Depresion",
    title = "Relacion entre uso de redes y riesgo de salud mental"
  )
```

### Sueño y estres

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(datos, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = stress_level, color = sleep_quality)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(
    x = "Horas de sueno",
    y = "Nivel de estres",
    color = "Calidad del sueno",
    title = "Sueño y estres segun calidad del sueno"
  )
```
